title: France may tie 5.5% solar VAT rate to RG5 hail resistance
content:
A forthcoming French decree could require RG5 hail-resistant modules and qualified installation for residential PV systems up to 9 kW to qualify for the reduced 5.5% value-added tax (VAT) rate.

title: Algeria’s solar capacity surpasses 1 GW
content:
Analysis by Rystad Energy finds that Algeria has added 760 MW of solar capacity this year following the commissioning of three major projects. International financing, grid expansion and regular procurement rounds will be key to achieving its 15 GW renewables target by 2035.

title: Gokin Solar launches 510 W all-black BC panel with 25.0% efficiency
content:
The Chinese manufacturer’s new double-glass, all-black modules are designed for high-end rooftop applications across Europe. They feature a temperature coefficient of -0.26% per C and a 30-year linear power output guarantee.

title: Felicity Solar showcases 20 kWh low-voltage residential battery
content:
The Chinese manufacturer’s new lithium iron phosphate battery features a maximum charging power of 10.2 kW, a maximum discharging power of 12.8 kW, and a depth of discharge of 95%. Up to 15 units can be connected in parallel for a total storage capacity of 300 kWh.

title: Differ Power unveils ‘9-in-1’ solar-storage heat pump
content:
The Chinese company has developed a residential heat pump system integrating a 6 kW hybrid inverter and supporting battery storage. The propane-based system comes in three versions with heating capacities ranging from 12 kW to 16 kW and can deliver hot water at temperatures of up to 75 C.

title: Pilot line recovers high-purity silver, silicon from PV panels
content:
Researchers have tested two routes for separating the layers of end-of-life solar panels on a pilot recycling line, recovering silver and silicon at purities above 99.99% and finding that a shockwave-based process also preserves a layer the heat-based route destroys.

title: Cyprus plans to deploy over 300 MW of battery storage
content:
With Cyprus having more than 1 GW of installed solar capacity against average electricity demand of around 650 MW, its government is looking to accelerate storage deployment to address rising solar curtailment and improve grid flexibility.

content:
